prompt: Refactor pricing.py from a hardcoded float prototype into a clean Decimal-based pricing engine supporting extensible rule families: (1) VolumeTierRule(tiers) where tiers is a list of (min_qty, discount_rate) selecting the highest qualifying tier on total quantity; (2) PromoCodeRule(code, discount_type, value, stackable=False) supporting 'percent' and 'fixed' discounts, where non-stackable promos never combine with each other or with stackable promos — pick the larger discount between the best single non-stackable promo and the sum of all applicable stackable promos (capped at post-volume subtotal); (3) TaxRule(rate) applied to (subtotal - discount_total). Expose PricingEngine(rules) with quote(items, promo_codes=None) returning {'subtotal': Decimal, 'discount_total': Decimal, 'tax_total': Decimal, 'total': Decimal, 'applied_rules': list[str]} rounded HALF_UP to 0.01, plus backward-compatible calculate_total(items, promo_code=None) returning Decimal.

checks.run: python3 -c "from decimal import Decimal; from pricing import PricingEngine, VolumeTierRule, PromoCodeRule, TaxRule, calculate_total; eng=PricingEngine([VolumeTierRule([(5, '0.05'), (10, '0.10')]), PromoCodeRule('STACK5', 'fixed', Decimal('5.00'), stackable=True), PromoCodeRule('STACK10P', 'percent', Decimal('0.10'), stackable=True), PromoCodeRule('VIP25', 'percent', Decimal('0.25'), stackable=False), TaxRule(Decimal('0.08'))]); items=[{'qty': 6, 'unit_price': '19.99'}]; q1=eng.quote(items, ['STACK5', 'STACK10P']); assert q1['subtotal']==Decimal('119.94'); assert q1['discount_total']==Decimal('22.39'); assert q1['tax_total']==Decimal('7.80'); assert q1['total']==Decimal('105.35'); assert 'volume:5' in q1['applied_rules'] and 'promo:STACK5' in q1['applied_rules']; q2=eng.quote(items, ['STACK5', 'STACK10P', 'VIP25']); assert q2['discount_total']==Decimal('34.49'); assert 'promo:VIP25' in q2['applied_rules'] and 'promo:STACK5' not in q2['applied_rules']; assert calculate_total([{'qty': 3, 'unit_price': '10.00'}], 'SAVE10')==Decimal('29.70')"

python3 -c "from decimal import Decimal; from pricing import PricingEngine, PromoCodeRule, TaxRule; eng=PricingEngine([PromoCodeRule('HUGE', 'fixed', Decimal('999.00')), TaxRule(Decimal('0.20'))]); q=eng.quote([{'qty': 1, 'unit_price': '0.10'}, {'qty': 1, 'unit_price': '0.20'}], ['HUGE']); assert q['subtotal']==Decimal('0.30'); assert q['discount_total']==Decimal('0.30'); assert q['tax_total']==Decimal('0.00'); assert q['total']==Decimal('0.00')"
